name: Takayashiki Jane Serika
original_name: 高屋敷・ジェーン・芹香
source:
She is a bright and energetic swimming club captain. She is well-liked and has many friends, both male and female.

Her mother is the school's director, and her father is British. Because her father is a devout Christian, she is forbidden to have premarital sex. She adores both her parents.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/sfc/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
